subject: Autonomy at [COMPANY] <> Encord
text:
Hi [NAME],

We've been working with Forterra on automating their lidar segmentation
scenes, and several other defense customers to develop their VLA policies
across multi cam and LiDAR sensor data.  Are either relevant bottlenecks
for you at the moment?

I lead GTM efforts for Physical AI at Encord where we partner with 300+
companies across ADAS/AV, robotics, drones, and space. Fast scaling
customers work with Encord because our platform handles multi-cam video, 3D
point, and telemetry data in the same interface, integrate best in class
models for pre-labeling, and flexible ontology schemas which allows us to
take on large annotation work loads to support your research and model
development efforts at scale.

I'd be keen to find 30 minutes in the next week or two to give you a brief
overview and understand your current workflows. Let me know if there is a
good day to do so and I'll share an invite for us to connect.

subject: multimodal training bottlenecks
text:
Hi [NAME], 

 Saw [COMPANY] is hiring across ML and DS, it sounds like [COMPANY]'s GenAI CORE work is pushing deeper into large-scale multimodal training and real-world quality. 

 In that stage, the blocker is rarely another training framework, it's getting the right data slice fast enough (hard negatives, rare prompts, failure modes) and keeping it versioned and explainable across iterations. 

 Encord is the data layer teams use to curate and align multimodal datasets and run human-in-the-loop review loops without stitching together internal tools. 

 Could we do 20 mins next week?

subject: audit-ready data // safe gaming & content moderation
text:
Hi 
      [NAME], 

      You've probably seen CSAM/CSEA prevention from every angle, curious how you're approaching compliance at [COMPANY]. 

      For context, Encord supports gaming and social platforms on the data layer behind detection and moderation models: curating & labeling rare and high-severity edge cases across channels (text/voice/image/video) regulators care most about, with consensus QA and an audit trail that holds up under DSA/OSA-style scrutiny. 

      Given you're actively supervising this function at [COMPANY], is this already in scope or still open? We'd love to explore avenues for collaboration.

subject: safe gaming & positive play
text:
Hi 
      Anad, 

      Came across your work leading positive player experience at EA, reaching out as we recently started working with another gaming company to reduce in-game toxicity 
      and improve content moderation. 

      For context, Encord works with platforms building the classifiers behind trust & safey systems: curating 
      and labeling messy, high-stakes edge cases (e.g. harassment, grooming signals, self-harm indicatpors in chat/voice) that moderation models need to catch, plus the QA 
      and audit trail regulators expect. 

      Given your focus, we'd love to chat about how we help similar teams validate training data for these models. 

      Open to spare 20min?

subject: video safety edge cases
text:
Hi 
      [NAME], 

      Scaling video review globally while holding the line on the hardest calls 
      (self-harm, suicide, extrmist CSAM-adjacent content) is a tough problem, and one most moderation models fail. 

      My team at Encord supports video and streaming platforms with the classifiers that triage this content before a human reviewer sees it, esp for rare and high-severity scenarios: labeling, expert consensus, and the audit trails regulators expect. 

      Curious whether tightening QA precision is under your purview?

      Worth 20min to compare notes?
